title: Finite bound for a reflexive transitive walk
statement: Let $E$ be a binary relation on the natural numbers and let $n\in\mathbb{N}$. If $t$ is reachable from $c$ by a finite sequence of steps, each from some $u<n$ to some $v<n$ with $E(u,v)$, then there is a natural number $j$ such that $t$ can be reached from $c$ using at most $j$ steps of this form.
hypotheses_covered: There is a reflexive transitive path from $c$ to $t$ whose edges satisfy $u<n$, $v<n$, and $E(u,v)$
